- **PO-2026-0107**: Antivirus ×1 (358,400), Monitor ×3 (2,148,600) → total 6,804,200 + tax = 7,552,662
- **Goods received (GR-2026-0107, 2026-10-13)**: Antivirus ×1, Monitor ×3 — the full ordered quantity, once.
- **Prior invoice LST-26-00364 (2026-10-15)**: total 7,552,662, same PO — this is exactly the same line/total.
- **This invoice LST-26-00371**: identical 7,552,662 for the same PO.

Total invoiced across both (2× antivirus, 6× monitors) exceeds what was received (1 antivirus, 3 monitors). Only one goods receipt exists, and LST-26-00364 already billed it in full. This is a resubmission, not a separate delivery.
